name: cable romanian deadlift
description: A hip hinge using a low cable. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with steady tension.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.
